# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I need help with an order. I want to swap the luggage set in it for a coat instead. If that’s not possible, I’d like to return just the luggage set. And if there are any issues with that, then I’d need to cancel the whole order.

My name is Aarav Lee, and I’m in Phoenix, AZ 85025. I don’t remember which email I used for the order.
aarav_lee_1982

{"user_id": "aarav_lee_1982", "name": {"first_name": "Aarav", "last_name": "Lee"}, "address": {"address1": "828 River Road", "address2": "Suite 312", "city": "Phoenix", "country": "USA", "state": "AZ", "zip": "85025"}, "email": "aarav.lee6460@example.com", "payment_methods": {"credit_card_1640996": {"source": "credit_card", "id": "credit_card_1640996", "brand": "visa", "last_four": "4451"}}, "orders": ["#W3361211", "#W3586556"]}

I found your account, Aarav.

Your account has 2 orders:
- #W3361211
- #W3586556

To help with the luggage set, I need to know which order it’s in. Please tell me the order ID.

Also, just so expectations are clear:
- exchanging a luggage set for a coat is not allowed, because exchanges can only be for a different option of the same product type
- if the order was delivered, I may be able to help you return just the luggage set
- if the order is still pending, I may be able to help cancel the whole order

Once you give me the order ID, I’ll check the status and details.

Thanks. I’m not sure which one has the luggage set. Could you check both and tell me which order includes it? Once we know that, I’d like to return just the luggage set if it’s already been delivered, or cancel the whole order if it’s still pending.
